title: [E-Documents Core] - Linkage & Traceability
summary: The E-Documents module now provides linkage and traceability by adding lookup functions to navigate from posted and ledger documents back to their associated E-Documents, with status and message FactBoxes displayed across all relevant sales, purchase, and service document pages.
key_points: New table methods enable finding E-Documents by document identity (number, posting date, partner, direction, type) with fallback logic for related document types
Status FactBox displays linked E-Document status and aggregated service delivery status across all transmission channels
Messages FactBox shows E-Document message history with ability to download raw XML payloads
Open E-Document action wired into 30+ document list and card pages across sales, purchase, service, and other modules
Comprehensive test coverage added for the new lookup and linkage procedures
